text: For a commutative ring R with 1 and an ideal M, the quotient R/M is a field if and only if M is:
explanation: Ideals of R/M correspond to ideals between M and R, so R/M has no proper nonzero ideals — i.e. is a field — exactly when M is maximal. The parallel fact: M prime ⇔ R/M is an integral domain, which is why maximal ⇒ prime.
